title: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
summary_full: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.
